sections.content:
Population change in Charnwood in 2032

The population in Charnwood is projected to increase from 185,266 people in 2022 to 204,246 people in 2032.

The biggest factor in this population change is net international migration, which will increase the population by 12,536 people.

This is different to the majority of areas in England, where net internal migration is projected to be the biggest factor in population change.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Charnwood
sections.subtitle: How the population is projected to change, by cause
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant
sections.note: The components of change do not always sum exactly to the total population change in an area. This is primarily due to the effect of constraining the final projections to the National Population Projections for England.

sections.content:
Population change is projected by looking at births and deaths (natural change) and people moving in and out of areas. In Charnwood, our projections show that between 2022 and 2032:

  • More deaths than births mean that the population is projected to decrease by 869, with 16,782 births and 17,651 deaths in Charnwood between 2022 and 2032. This means natural change would decrease the population in Charnwood by 0.5%, compared with an increase of 0.2% in England.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other local authorities in England) is projected to increase the population by 7,858, with 176,297 people moving to the area and 168,440 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Charnwood by 4.2%.
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) is not projected to change the population substantially, with 4,803 people moving to the area and 4,955 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032.
  • Net international migration is projected to increase the population by 12,536, with 23,179 people moving to the area and 10,643 people moving from the area between 2022 and 2032. This would increase the population in Charnwood by 6.8%, compared with an increase of 6.5% in England.

sections.content:
Age profile in Charnwood in 2032

The median age in Charnwood is projected to rise from 39 years in 2022 to 41 years in 2032.

In England, the median age is projected to be 41 years in 2032.

In 2032, 20% of the population in Charnwood are projected to be aged 65 years or over, up from 18% in 2022.

sections.title: The 50 to 59 age group are set to see the largest change in Charnwood between 2022 and 2032
sections.subtitle: Percentages of population by 10 year age bands, 2022 and 2032
sections.source: Subnational population projections for England from Office for National Statistics – Migration category variant

sections.content:
Between 2022 and 2032, the share of the working age population (people aged 16 years to State Pension age) in Charnwood is projected to stay the same, at around 65%.

The old age dependency ratio (the number of people of State Pension age for every 1,000 people of working age) is projected to rise from 278 to 285 over the same time period.

This is around average for England in 2032 (287 per 1,000). Nationally, a high old age dependency ratio means more older people are financially reliant on the working age population to pay for pensions.

How will the number of young people change in Charnwood?

In 2032, 19% of people are projected to be aged 18 years and under, down from 20% in 2022.

This is below average for England in 2032 (20%).

Looking at the youngest age groups in Charnwood between 2022 and 2032, we can see the share of:

  • Infants (aged 0 to 4 years) will fall from 5% to 4%
  • Primary school age children (aged 5 to 11 years) will fall from 8% to 7%
  • Secondary school age children and sixth-form age (aged 12 to 18 years) will stay around the same, at 7%
